title: LightCarbon LCG071S-PRO frameset (current product page)
notes: Current manufacturer page identifies item LCG071S-PRO and states T700/T800 carbon with one-piece 3D latex-mandrel molding. It publishes size-specific frame weights (including the downtube lid, +/-40 g), 49/52/55/58 geometry, threaded T47, UDH, 700x50C/650B 2.1/29er 1.95 clearance, ISO4210 testing, compatible mechanical and Di2 groupsets, and a two-year warranty. Its claimed 30% strength improvement is manufacturer marketing without a published protocol and is not treated as a stiffness measurement. Mainland CNY checkout pricing is not exposed.
